Title: TC_B10-55168_001_Config_Add_Exactly_200_MIDs_To_Exclusion_List
Description: Validates that the admin portal accepts and persists a MID exclusion list of exactly 200 entries for the generic 1% cashback perk — confirming the new capacity ceiling is fully functional (AC1).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal. B10-55168 has been deployed to the test environment. The current MID exclusion list has fewer than 200 entries. At least 200 valid test MIDs are prepared.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and navigate to the Perks configuration section for the generic cashback perk.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in and the generic cashback perk configuration page is displayed.

Title: TC_B10-55168_001_Config_Add_Exactly_200_MIDs_To_Exclusion_List
Step: View the current MID exclusion list and record the current entry count.
Expected Result: Current entry count is visible and is below 200. The UI renders all existing entries without truncation.

Title: TC_B10-55168_001_Config_Add_Exactly_200_MIDs_To_Exclusion_List
Step: Add valid test MIDs sequentially until the total list size reaches exactly 200.
Expected Result: Each MID is accepted by the form without error. The running count or list size reflects the addition correctly.

Title: TC_B10-55168_001_Config_Add_Exactly_200_MIDs_To_Exclusion_List
Step: Click Save / Confirm to persist the 200-MID configuration.
Expected Result: Configuration is saved successfully. A success confirmation message is displayed. No timeout or server error occurs.

Title: TC_B10-55168_001_Config_Add_Exactly_200_MIDs_To_Exclusion_List
Step: Reload the configuration page and inspect the saved exclusion list.
Expected Result: All 200 MIDs are present in the saved list — none were silently truncated or dropped. The displayed count confirms 200 entries.

Title: TC_B10-55168_002_Config_Attempt_201st_MID_Exceeds_Capacity
Description: Validates that the system prevents adding a 201st MID beyond the 200-entry capacity ceiling — ensuring the new limit is enforced at both the UI and API levels (AC1 boundary).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal. The current MID exclusion list contains exactly 200 entries. B10-55168 has been deployed to the test environment.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and navigate to the Perks exclusion configuration page.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in. The exclusion list showing 200 entries is displayed.

Title: TC_B10-55168_002_Config_Attempt_201st_MID_Exceeds_Capacity
Step: Confirm the list contains exactly 200 MIDs.
Expected Result: The list shows exactly 200 entries. Adding a 201st entry should be blocked.

Title: TC_B10-55168_002_Config_Attempt_201st_MID_Exceeds_Capacity
Step: Attempt to add one additional valid MID via the admin UI.
Expected Result: The system blocks the addition. Either the input control is disabled/greyed out at the 200-entry limit, or an inline validation message is shown stating the maximum capacity of 200 has been reached.

Title: TC_B10-55168_002_Config_Attempt_201st_MID_Exceeds_Capacity
Step: Attempt to bypass the UI by calling the backend configuration API directly with a payload containing 201 MIDs.
Expected Result: The API returns an error status (e.g. HTTP 400 Bad Request) with an appropriate error message. The exclusion list on the backend remains at exactly 200 entries — no partial write occurs.

Title: TC_B10-55168_003_Config_Add_First_MID_To_Empty_Exclusion_List
Description: Validates that an admin can add a MID to an empty (0-entry) exclusion list without errors — confirming the minimum boundary works correctly under the new capacity implementation (AC1 / AC5).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal. The generic cashback perk exclusion list is empty (0 entries) in a test configuration. B10-55168 has been deployed.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and navigate to the Perks exclusion configuration page.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in. The configuration page shows an empty exclusion list (0 entries).

Title: TC_B10-55168_003_Config_Add_First_MID_To_Empty_Exclusion_List
Step: Enter a single valid test MID into the exclusion list input field.
Expected Result: The input field accepts the MID without any validation errors.

Title: TC_B10-55168_003_Config_Add_First_MID_To_Empty_Exclusion_List
Step: Click Save / Confirm.
Expected Result: Configuration is saved successfully. A confirmation message is displayed.

Title: TC_B10-55168_003_Config_Add_First_MID_To_Empty_Exclusion_List
Step: Reload the configuration page and verify the saved list.
Expected Result: The saved MID appears in the exclusion list. The count shows exactly 1 entry.

Title: TC_B10-55168_004_Config_Expand_Beyond_Old_60_MID_Limit
Description: Validates that the system correctly accepts MID entries at positions 61 through 200 — the previously unsupported range under the old 50-60 MID capacity. This is the core functional expansion test for B10-55168 (AC1).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal. The exclusion list currently contains exactly 60 MIDs (the old capacity limit). B10-55168 has been deployed. Valid test MIDs for positions 61–200 are prepared.
Step: Log in to the admin portal. Navigate to the Perks exclusion configuration. Confirm the list has exactly 60 entries.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in. The exclusion list shows 60 entries. The old capacity ceiling should no longer apply.

Title: TC_B10-55168_004_Config_Expand_Beyond_Old_60_MID_Limit
Step: Add a new MID as the 61st entry and click Save.
Expected Result: The 61st MID is accepted without error — the old capacity limit is not enforced. Configuration saves successfully with a confirmation.

Title: TC_B10-55168_004_Config_Expand_Beyond_Old_60_MID_Limit
Step: Continue adding MIDs in increments (reaching 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 / 180 entries) saving after each group.
Expected Result: Each incremental save succeeds without error. The running count increases correctly at every checkpoint.

Title: TC_B10-55168_004_Config_Expand_Beyond_Old_60_MID_Limit
Step: Add remaining MIDs until the total count reaches exactly 200 and perform a final save.
Expected Result: All 200 MIDs are saved. No error or timeout occurs at any count between 61 and 200.

Title: TC_B10-55168_004_Config_Expand_Beyond_Old_60_MID_Limit
Step: Reload the configuration page and verify the complete list.
Expected Result: All 200 entries are present — list is complete and consistent. No entries from the original 60 were lost during expansion.

Title: TC_B10-55168_005_Behavior_Excluded_MID_No_Generic_Cashback
Description: Validates that a merchant whose MID is in the exclusion list does not trigger the generic 1% cashback perk for card transactions — confirming the core perk-suppression behavior of AC2.
Pre-conditions: A test merchant MID (MID_EXCLUDED_TEST) is added to the exclusion list and the configuration is saved. A test card user with sufficient balance is available. A card transaction can be simulated in the test environment.
Step: Verify that MID_EXCLUDED_TEST is present in the saved generic cashback exclusion list.
Expected Result: MID_EXCLUDED_TEST appears in the exclusion list configuration.

Title: TC_B10-55168_005_Behavior_Excluded_MID_No_Generic_Cashback
Step: Simulate a card transaction of 100 EGP at the merchant with MID_EXCLUDED_TEST.
Expected Result: Transaction is processed successfully. The card account is debited by 100 EGP.

Title: TC_B10-55168_005_Behavior_Excluded_MID_No_Generic_Cashback
Step: Navigate to the card user's transaction history or perk history.
Expected Result: The transaction appears with the correct merchant and amount.

Title: TC_B10-55168_005_Behavior_Excluded_MID_No_Generic_Cashback
Step: Check whether a generic 1% cashback entry was credited for this transaction.
Expected Result: No generic cashback perk entry is present. The user's cashback balance did not increase by any amount derived from 1% of the transaction. The exclusion is working correctly.

Title: TC_B10-55168_006_Behavior_Non_Excluded_MID_Generic_Cashback_Applies
Description: Validates that a merchant NOT in the exclusion list continues to trigger the generic 1% cashback perk — confirming AC2 is not over-applied and the baseline cashback behavior is preserved for eligible merchants.
Pre-conditions: A test merchant MID (MID_NON_EXCLUDED_TEST) is confirmed NOT present in the exclusion list. A test card user is available. The generic cashback perk is active and operational.
Step: Verify that MID_NON_EXCLUDED_TEST is NOT present in the generic cashback exclusion list.
Expected Result: MID_NON_EXCLUDED_TEST does not appear in the exclusion list. All saved exclusion MIDs are reviewed to confirm only the intended merchants are listed.

Title: TC_B10-55168_006_Behavior_Non_Excluded_MID_Generic_Cashback_Applies
Step: Simulate a card transaction of 100 EGP at the merchant with MID_NON_EXCLUDED_TEST.
Expected Result: Transaction is processed successfully.

Title: TC_B10-55168_006_Behavior_Non_Excluded_MID_Generic_Cashback_Applies
Step: Navigate to the card user's perk or transaction history and check for a cashback entry.
Expected Result: A generic 1% cashback perk entry (1 EGP for 100 EGP transaction) is credited to the user's account. The perk type is correctly labeled as the generic cashback perk. Amount and type are accurate.

Title: TC_B10-55168_007_Behavior_Excluded_Merchant_With_Specific_Perk_No_Double_Perk
Description: Validates that when an excluded merchant also has a merchant-specific perk configured, only the merchant-specific perk is applied and the generic cashback is suppressed — confirming AC2 and AC3 and that no double perk occurs.
Pre-conditions: A merchant (MID_SPECIFIC_PERK) is configured with an active merchant-specific perk (e.g. 5% cashback). MID_SPECIFIC_PERK is also added to the generic cashback exclusion list. Both configurations are saved. A test card user is available.
Step: Verify that MID_SPECIFIC_PERK is present in both the exclusion list AND has an active merchant-specific perk configured.
Expected Result: Both configurations are confirmed active via the admin portal.

Title: TC_B10-55168_007_Behavior_Excluded_Merchant_With_Specific_Perk_No_Double_Perk
Step: Simulate a card transaction of 100 EGP at MID_SPECIFIC_PERK.
Expected Result: Transaction processes successfully. The account is debited 100 EGP.

Title: TC_B10-55168_007_Behavior_Excluded_Merchant_With_Specific_Perk_No_Double_Perk
Step: Navigate to the card user's perk history and inspect all perk entries for this transaction.
Expected Result: Exactly one perk entry is credited: the merchant-specific perk only (e.g. 5 EGP for 5% of 100 EGP). The perk type correctly identifies the merchant-specific perk.

Title: TC_B10-55168_007_Behavior_Excluded_Merchant_With_Specific_Perk_No_Double_Perk
Step: Verify that no generic 1% cashback entry was credited alongside the merchant-specific perk.
Expected Result: No generic cashback entry exists for this transaction. No double perk has occurred. The user received the merchant-specific deal without the generic 1% on top — consistent with the exclusion list intent.

Title: TC_B10-55168_008_Behavior_Merchant_Specific_Perks_Apply_Normally
Description: Validates that all existing merchant-specific perks continue to apply correctly after the B10-55168 MID exclusion capacity upgrade — confirming AC3 and ensuring the capacity change introduces no regressions to the merchant perk engine.
Pre-conditions: A merchant (MID_WITH_PERK) has an active merchant-specific perk configured. MID_WITH_PERK is NOT in the generic cashback exclusion list. B10-55168 has been deployed to the test environment.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and verify that MID_WITH_PERK has an active merchant-specific perk configured.
Expected Result: The merchant-specific perk is active with correct perk type and value.

Title: TC_B10-55168_008_Behavior_Merchant_Specific_Perks_Apply_Normally
Step: Simulate a card transaction at MID_WITH_PERK.
Expected Result: Transaction processes successfully.

Title: TC_B10-55168_008_Behavior_Merchant_Specific_Perks_Apply_Normally
Step: Check the card user's perk history for the transaction.
Expected Result: The merchant-specific perk is credited with the correct type, amount, and merchant attribution.

Title: TC_B10-55168_008_Behavior_Merchant_Specific_Perks_Apply_Normally
Step: Compare perk behavior to the same merchant transaction performed before B10-55168 was deployed.
Expected Result: The perk amount and behavior are identical to pre-deployment behavior. No regression is introduced to merchant-specific perk logic by the capacity increase.

Title: TC_B10-55168_009_DataIntegrity_Existing_MIDs_Unchanged_Post_Deployment
Description: Validates that all Merchant IDs previously in the exclusion list (up to 60 entries under the old limit) remain intact and unmodified after the B10-55168 capacity upgrade is deployed — confirming AC4 and that no data migration side-effect occurred.
Pre-conditions: B10-55168 has just been deployed to the test environment. A pre-deployment snapshot of the MID exclusion list has been captured and is available for comparison. Admin credentials are available.
Step: Immediately after deployment, log in to the admin portal and navigate to the Perks exclusion configuration.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in. The configuration page loads successfully, showing the MID exclusion list.

Title: TC_B10-55168_009_DataIntegrity_Existing_MIDs_Unchanged_Post_Deployment
Step: Compare the current MID exclusion list against the pre-deployment snapshot (count and values).
Expected Result: All pre-existing MIDs are present. The count matches exactly. No entries were removed, added, or altered by the deployment.

Title: TC_B10-55168_009_DataIntegrity_Existing_MIDs_Unchanged_Post_Deployment
Step: Verify the value and order of each pre-existing MID entry matches the snapshot exactly.
Expected Result: No MIDs were reordered, duplicated, or had their values modified. Data integrity is fully preserved.

Title: TC_B10-55168_009_DataIntegrity_Existing_MIDs_Unchanged_Post_Deployment
Step: Simulate a transaction at one of the pre-existing excluded merchants (a MID from the original list).
Expected Result: The generic cashback perk is NOT applied. Pre-existing exclusions remain effective — the capacity upgrade did not break any existing exclusion.

Title: TC_B10-55168_010_Admin_Add_MID_Without_Technical_Intervention
Description: Validates that a commercial team admin can add a new MID to the exclusion list using only the admin UI — without requiring any developer action, DB script, or system redeployment (AC5).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal with commercial team or admin role. B10-55168 has been deployed. A new test MID (MID_NEW_ADMIN_TEST) is available and not yet in the exclusion list.
Step: Log in to the admin portal using commercial team or admin credentials (not developer/DevOps credentials).
Expected Result: Admin is logged in using standard commercial team access. No elevated technical permissions are required.

Title: TC_B10-55168_010_Admin_Add_MID_Without_Technical_Intervention
Step: Navigate to the Perks configuration section for the generic cashback perk using only the admin UI navigation.
Expected Result: The configuration page is reachable via admin UI menus without direct URL manipulation or developer tooling.

Title: TC_B10-55168_010_Admin_Add_MID_Without_Technical_Intervention
Step: Enter MID_NEW_ADMIN_TEST into the exclusion list input and click Save.
Expected Result: The MID is added and the configuration saves successfully with a confirmation message.

Title: TC_B10-55168_010_Admin_Add_MID_Without_Technical_Intervention
Step: Verify MID_NEW_ADMIN_TEST appears in the saved exclusion list on page reload.
Expected Result: MID_NEW_ADMIN_TEST is visible in the list. The entire add operation was completed via the self-service admin UI — no developer, DevOps, or DB admin action was required at any step.

Title: TC_B10-55168_011_Admin_Remove_MID_Via_UI
Description: Validates that an admin can remove an existing MID from the exclusion list via the admin UI and that the removal takes effect such that the merchant's subsequent transactions receive the generic cashback (AC5 / AC2).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged into the admin portal. A MID (MID_TO_REMOVE) is present in the exclusion list. A test card user and transaction simulation environment are available.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and navigate to the Perks exclusion configuration page.
Expected Result: Admin is logged in. The exclusion list is displayed with MID_TO_REMOVE visible.

Title: TC_B10-55168_011_Admin_Remove_MID_Via_UI
Step: Select MID_TO_REMOVE and click Remove / Delete via the UI.
Expected Result: MID_TO_REMOVE is removed from the in-memory list. The UI updates to reflect the removal immediately, and the count decrements by 1.

Title: TC_B10-55168_011_Admin_Remove_MID_Via_UI
Step: Click Save to persist the removal.
Expected Result: Configuration is saved successfully. A confirmation is shown.

Title: TC_B10-55168_011_Admin_Remove_MID_Via_UI
Step: Reload the configuration page and verify MID_TO_REMOVE is no longer listed.
Expected Result: MID_TO_REMOVE does not appear in the saved exclusion list. Count has decreased by exactly 1.

Title: TC_B10-55168_011_Admin_Remove_MID_Via_UI
Step: Simulate a card transaction at the merchant with MID_TO_REMOVE.
Expected Result: The generic 1% cashback perk IS credited for this transaction — confirming the MID removal took effect and the merchant is no longer excluded from the generic perk.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Description: Validates the lower boundary of maximum capacity: exactly 199 MIDs can be saved and all 199 exclusions are enforced at transaction evaluation time. Confirms adjacent-boundary accuracy.
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged in. The exclusion list can be configured to exactly 199 entries. A transaction simulation environment is available. MIDs at positions 1 and 199 are known.
Step: Configure the exclusion list to contain exactly 199 MIDs and save.
Expected Result: Configuration saves successfully. No error or truncation occurs at 199 entries.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Step: Reload the configuration page and confirm the entry count.
Expected Result: The list shows exactly 199 entries — neither 198 nor 200.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Step: Simulate a transaction at the MID at list position 1.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — the first entry in the 199-entry list is excluded correctly.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Step: Simulate a transaction at the MID at list position 199.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — the last entry in the 199-entry list is excluded. No off-by-one error in exclusion lookup.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Step: Simulate a transaction at a MID NOT in the 199-entry list.
Expected Result: Generic 1% cashback IS applied — the exclusion list does not inadvertently exclude merchants beyond the configured entries.

Title: TC_B10-55168_012_Boundary_199_MIDs_Saves_And_Functions
Step: Add one more MID to bring the total to 200 and save.
Expected Result: The 200th MID is accepted and saved. Total count is confirmed at 200.

Title: TC_B10-55168_013_Boundary_All_200_Excluded_MIDs_Evaluated_At_Transaction_Time
Description: Validates that the perk evaluation engine processes all 200 MIDs in the exclusion list at transaction time — testing entries at the first, middle, and last list positions to confirm no truncation in the lookup logic.
Pre-conditions: The exclusion list contains exactly 200 MIDs. The MIDs at positions 1, 100, and 200 are identified and noted. A transaction simulation environment is available.
Step: Verify the exclusion list contains exactly 200 MIDs and note the specific MIDs at list positions 1 / 100 / 200.
Expected Result: All three reference MIDs are confirmed present in the list at their respective positions.

Title: TC_B10-55168_013_Boundary_All_200_Excluded_MIDs_Evaluated_At_Transaction_Time
Step: Simulate a card transaction at the merchant with MID at position 1.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — the first MID in the full 200-entry list is excluded correctly at transaction evaluation time.

Title: TC_B10-55168_013_Boundary_All_200_Excluded_MIDs_Evaluated_At_Transaction_Time
Step: Simulate a card transaction at the merchant with MID at position 100.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — a mid-list MID is excluded correctly. No truncation at the midpoint of the list.

Title: TC_B10-55168_013_Boundary_All_200_Excluded_MIDs_Evaluated_At_Transaction_Time
Step: Simulate a card transaction at the merchant with MID at position 200.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — the last MID in the full 200-entry list is excluded correctly. The perk engine reads and evaluates all 200 entries without truncation at the tail.

Title: TC_B10-55168_013_Boundary_All_200_Excluded_MIDs_Evaluated_At_Transaction_Time
Step: Simulate a transaction at a merchant with a MID not in the exclusion list (position 201 equivalent).
Expected Result: Generic 1% cashback IS applied — confirming the boundary is exact at 200 and the perk engine does not over-exclude.

Title: TC_B10-55168_014_Validation_Duplicate_MID_Not_Inflating_List
Description: Validates that the system handles an attempt to add an already-existing MID gracefully — either rejecting with a clear error or silently deduplicating — and that the list count is not inflated by duplicates.
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged in. The exclusion list contains at least one known MID (MID_DUPLICATE_TEST). B10-55168 has been deployed. Current list count is N.
Step: Log in to the admin portal and navigate to the exclusion list configuration. Confirm MID_DUPLICATE_TEST is in the list at count N.
Expected Result: MID_DUPLICATE_TEST is visible in the existing exclusion list. List count is N.

Title: TC_B10-55168_014_Validation_Duplicate_MID_Not_Inflating_List
Step: Attempt to add MID_DUPLICATE_TEST again to the exclusion list via the admin UI and save.
Expected Result: System responds with either: (a) an inline validation error stating the MID already exists — preferred UX; or (b) the duplicate is silently deduped and the list remains at N entries. In both cases the list count must NOT increase to N+1.

Title: TC_B10-55168_014_Validation_Duplicate_MID_Not_Inflating_List
Step: Reload the configuration page and verify the list count.
Expected Result: List count is still N. No duplicate entry for MID_DUPLICATE_TEST exists in the saved list.

Title: TC_B10-55168_014_Validation_Duplicate_MID_Not_Inflating_List
Step: Simulate a transaction at MID_DUPLICATE_TEST.
Expected Result: No generic cashback is applied — the exclusion for this MID is still working correctly after the duplicate attempt.

Title: TC_B10-55168_015_Validation_Invalid_MID_Format_Rejected
Description: Validates that the admin UI and API reject malformed MID values with clear validation errors — preventing corrupt or dangerous data from entering the exclusion list (input validation / security hardening).
Pre-conditions: Admin is logged in. B10-55168 has been deployed. The exclusion list is in a known valid state.
Step: Attempt to enter an empty string as a MID and click Save.
Expected Result: The system rejects the empty entry with a clear validation error message. No empty string entry is added to the list.

Title: TC_B10-55168_015_Validation_Invalid_MID_Format_Rejected
Step: Attempt to enter a MID containing only special characters (e.g. !@#$%^&*) and Save.
Expected Result: System rejects the input with a validation error. The list is unchanged.

Title: TC_B10-55168_015_Validation_Invalid_MID_Format_Rejected
Step: Attempt to enter a MID exceeding the maximum expected character length (e.g. a 500-character string) and Save.
Expected Result: System truncates or rejects the oversized input. No excessively long value is persisted in the backend. Input field enforces a maximum length.

Title: TC_B10-55168_015_Validation_Invalid_MID_Format_Rejected
Step: Attempt to enter a SQL injection payload (e.g. ' OR '1'='1' --) as a MID and Save.
Expected Result: System sanitizes or rejects the input. No SQL injection is executed against the database. The exclusion list is unchanged.

Title: TC_B10-55168_015_Validation_Invalid_MID_Format_Rejected
Step: After all invalid entry attempts
Expected Result: reload the configuration page and review the exclusion list.
column12: The exclusion list contains only the original valid entries. No corrupt, empty, or malformed MIDs were persisted at any point.

Title: TC_B10-55168_016_Security_Unauthorized_User_Cannot_Modify_Exclusion_List
Description: Validates that only authorized admin users can modify the MID exclusion list — non-admin roles receive appropriate access denials at both the UI and API levels, preventing unauthorized perk configuration changes (AC5 / security).
Pre-conditions: A non-admin test user account (e.g. read-only analyst role) is available. The admin portal is accessible. The backend API endpoint for updating the MID exclusion list is identifiable. B10-55168 has been deployed.
Step: Log in to the admin portal with a non-admin / read-only user account.
Expected Result: Non-admin user is logged in.

Title: TC_B10-55168_016_Security_Unauthorized_User_Cannot_Modify_Exclusion_List
Step: Navigate to the Perks configuration section for the generic cashback perk.
Expected Result: Either the configuration page is inaccessible (hidden from navigation / HTTP 403 returned), or the page renders but all edit controls (MID input, Save button) are disabled or absent.

Title: TC_B10-55168_016_Security_Unauthorized_User_Cannot_Modify_Exclusion_List
Step: Attempt to submit a MID list update via direct API call using the non-admin user's auth token.
Expected Result: The API returns HTTP 401 (Unauthorized) or HTTP 403 (Forbidden). The exclusion list is not modified. No partial write occurs on the backend.

Title: TC_B10-55168_016_Security_Unauthorized_User_Cannot_Modify_Exclusion_List
Step: After the unauthorized attempt
Expected Result: verify the exclusion list is unchanged.
column12: The exclusion list content and count are identical to the pre-test state. No unauthorized modification occurred through either the UI or the API.

Title: TC_B10-55168_017_Regression_Generic_Cashback_Still_Works_For_Non_Excluded_Merchants
Description: Validates that the generic 1% cashback perk continues to apply normally for merchants not in the exclusion list after the B10-55168 capacity increase is deployed — ensuring no regression in baseline cashback eligibility.

Expected Result: MID_REGRESSION_CASHBACK does not appear in the exclusion list. The merchant is eligible for generic cashback.

Title: TC_B10-55168_017_Regression_Generic_Cashback_Still_Works_For_Non_Excluded_Merchants
Step: Simulate a card transaction of 200 EGP at MID_REGRESSION_CASHBACK.
Expected Result: Transaction is processed successfully.

Title: TC_B10-55168_017_Regression_Generic_Cashback_Still_Works_For_Non_Excluded_Merchants
Step: Navigate to the card user's perk history and verify the cashback entry.
Expected Result: A generic 1% cashback entry of 2 EGP (1% of 200 EGP) is credited. Perk type is correctly labeled as generic cashback. Amount is accurate. No regression in cashback calculation or eligibility logic.

Title: TC_B10-55168_018_Regression_Pre_Existing_Exclusions_Still_Block_Generic_Cashback
Description: Validates that merchants excluded under the old capacity limit (MIDs 1–60) continue to have their generic cashback suppressed after the B10-55168 upgrade — ensuring no regression in existing exclusion enforcement (AC4 regression).

Title: TC_B10-55168_018_Regression_Pre_Existing_Exclusions_Still_Block_Generic_Cashback
Step: Simulate a card transaction of 100 EGP at the merchant with MID_OLD_EXCLUDED.
Expected Result: Transaction processes successfully.

Title: TC_B10-55168_018_Regression_Pre_Existing_Exclusions_Still_Block_Generic_Cashback
Step: Check the card user's perk history for a generic cashback entry from this transaction.
Expected Result: No generic cashback entry is present for this transaction. The pre-existing exclusion is still fully enforced post-upgrade. No regression in exclusion logic for the original MID set.

Title: TC_B10-55168_019_Config_Change_Takes_Effect_Without_System_Restart
Description: Validates that a newly added MID exclusion takes effect immediately (or within the defined propagation window) without any application restart or redeployment — confirming the admin self-service capability of AC5.

Step: Simulate a baseline transaction at MID_PROPAGATION_TEST and confirm generic cashback IS credited.
Expected Result: Generic 1% cashback is credited — confirming MID_PROPAGATION_TEST is not excluded. This establishes the pre-exclusion baseline.

Title: TC_B10-55168_019_Config_Change_Takes_Effect_Without_System_Restart
Step: Add MID_PROPAGATION_TEST to the exclusion list via the admin UI and save — without restarting any application service.
Expected Result: Configuration is saved. No service restart is performed at any point.

Title: TC_B10-55168_019_Config_Change_Takes_Effect_Without_System_Restart
Step: Wait for the expected configuration propagation window (confirm timing with the engineering team — typically near-immediate or within 60 seconds for DB-driven configuration).
Expected Result: The propagation window elapses. No manual cache flush or restart is performed.

Title: TC_B10-55168_019_Config_Change_Takes_Effect_Without_System_Restart
Step: Simulate another transaction at MID_PROPAGATION_TEST after the propagation window.
